items.followUp: What is the purpose of routing in a computer network?

rubric.why: Shows that routing determines a suitable path for data to travel.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that routing determines the best route or path.

rubric.why: Shows how routers use the selected route to move data through the network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that routers forward packets along the route towards the destination.

modelAnswer: Routing determines the best route or path for data packets to travel from the source to the destination.
Routers use this route to forward packets through the network.
